Subject: Draft: Liftbridge Logistics case review & quote confirmation

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the great call last week. Attached is our first draft of the case study (liftbridge_case_draft_v1.docx) and the quote spreadsheet we referenced. We'd like your help with two quick things so we can move to publication:

1) Fact-check the usage stats in section 2 (monthly queries, average latency) — we pulled these from the pilot dashboard but want Liftbridge to confirm.
2) Approve the quote line we included for production-day capacity (sheet: "Capacity Pricing"). We marked the row in yellow where your team should confirm or propose changes.

If you and the legal/marketing teams could return redlines by EOD Thursday (4/22), we'll push the revisions and aim for a May 3 publish. If that timeline doesn't work, tell us the best date and we'll adjust.

Attachments: liftbridge_case_draft_v1.docx, liftbridge_quote_2027-04-19.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Asha Menon <asha@liftbridge.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@liftbridge.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Liftbridge Logistics case review & quote confirmation

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for sending this over. I reviewed the draft and attached a PDF with inline comments (liftbridge_redlines_asha.pdf). High-level notes:

- The monthly queries number in paragraph 2 should be 8.7M (not 870K) — looks like a decimal point got dropped.
- The latency figure is correct, but please change the phrasing from "sub-60ms" to "median 58ms" so it's sourced correctly.
- We need to remove the sentence about "Liftbridge saved $1.2M in GPU costs" — finance asked that any dollar savings be left out unless we provide audited details.
- Legal asks for a short attribution line for quote approvals: please add "Quote approved by Liftbridge Finance on Apr 19, 2027" in the appendix.

On the quote sheet: the committed burst capacity line (row 14) needs to reflect our negotiated 25% burst, not 40%. I attached an annotated XLSX — but since you already sent the sheet, I called out the exact cell in the PDF.

We're generally happy to be a reference and approve publication once these edits are made and we get final sign-off from finance (should be quick).

I'll aim to return a signed approval by Friday (4/23) assuming the above edits are incorporated.

Best,
Asha Menon
Director, Product Ops | Liftbridge Logistics
asha@liftbridge.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Liftbridge Logistics case review & quote confirmation

Priyom / Monica —

Thanks Asha for the clear notes. Quick internal checklist:
- Update numbers: fix 870K -> 8.7M and change latency phrasing to "median 58ms" (Marissa).
- Remove the $1.2M savings sentence and add a placeholder attribution line in the appendix per Asha's request (Monica).
- Update quote workbook: change burst from 40% to 25% and mark the cell with a comment explaining the negotiated term (Priyom).
- Re-run the PDF proof and send back to Asha with a tracked-changes copy and the updated quote.

Timeline: I can do the doc edits this morning; Monica will update the appendix language and legal-friendly phrasing. Priyom, can you own the quote workbook update and return everything to Asha by 3 PM PT today so we stay on their Friday approval target?

Also, small ask: Asha requested a one-line attribution for approved quotes in the appendix. We should have a standard approved-quote sentence template for future shows. I'll create that and drop in the shared doc.

-Marissa
Senior Manager, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Asha Menon <asha@liftbridge.ai>

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the updated draft and spreadsheet; all the edits look good. Two minor copy suggestions in the conclusion (attached as comments in the Google Doc): change "edge-based inference" to "edge-optimized inference" and expand the customer quote by one sentence to mention "reduced orchestration overhead."

Legal/Finance sign-off: finance confirmed the quote change to 25% burst and legal approves the redlines. We are comfortable giving Redwood permission to publish on May 5, 2027. Please email the final PDF to contracts@liftbridge.ai for our records when published.

Permission granted: Liftbridge Logistics approves publication pending final proof. You have our permission to use the quote attributed to "Asha Menon, Director, Product Ops, Liftbridge Logistics."

Thanks,
Asha
